jobDescriptions.summary: Join the engineering team to build high-scale cloud platforms, distributed systems, and collaborative web developer tools.
education_requirements: Pursuing Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
responsibilities: Design, build and test software components that scale efficiently.
Collaborate with product and telemetry teams to optimize UX and performance.
Practice rigorous code review, automated testing, and CI/CD.

jobDescriptions.summary: Craft frictionless payment user experiences and high-performance design system components.
education_requirements: B.Tech / BS in Computer Science or Equivalent Experience
responsibilities: Develop accessible, interactive web interfaces for developer dashboards.
Optimize bundle sizes, latency, and Core Web Vitals across millions of daily views.
Collaborate with UX designers to evolve design system tokens.

jobDescriptions.summary: Work on training pipelines, LLM fine-tuning, retrieval agents, and low-latency inference endpoints.
education_requirements: Pursuing MS or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or Mathematics
responsibilities: Implement and benchmark frontier LLM evaluations and agent reasoning workflows.
Optimize memory footprints and inference pipelines using quantization and caching.
Publish reproducible technical notes and documentation.
